text:
Nida (CS): quick ask 1: creating a tiny customer-facing runbook for go-live: caching, batching, streaming + renewal watchlist. need a short checklist + copyable config + 2 auto-flags.

Owen (SE): copyable config: 
```
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 900
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 4
  max_batch_size: 12
  jitter_ms: 30
streaming:
  enable_streaming: true
  partial_retry_limit: 1
```

Priya (CS): customer checklist (3 steps):
1) PRELAUNCH: run top-5 prompts, record med + p95
2) LAUNCH: enable prefill + start with small batching
3) RAMP: run 30-min warm pool, confirm cache_hit_rate and p95 within target

Marco (Product): renewal auto-flags to surface:
- cache_hit_rate drop > 35% over 24h -> tag renewal_risk
- p95 latency > SLA + 250ms for 1h -> page CS + SE
These trigger a paired CS/SE runbook.

Owen (SE): debugging tips: set jitter_ms=0 for a short run to surface raw concurrency; enable tracing for 5-10m; check cache hit distribution by session length.

Priya (CS): feedback capture plan: day0 (24h), day3, day14. 3 q's: latency ok? errors? paste 3 critical prompts. Attach to account notes.

NotifyBot: template saved: "CS Go-live Snapshot: Warmup & Streaming" by Nida.

Nida (CS): action items: I'll draft 1-page + 2-slide renewal snapshot (ETA tomorrow). Owen: add YAML to onboarding repo (24h). Priya: schedule two paired dry-runs this week. Thanks!
